stories.title: Hope fading for survivors a week after Nepal flash flood
stories.summary: Rescuers in Nepal's mountains are still searching for survivors a week after a glacier-collapse flood swept villages near the Tibet border, killing more than 1,100 and leaving thousands missing. The disaster has strained Himalayan rescue operations stretched across two nations.

stories.title: Flash flood in Grand Canyon kills at least 2, a dozen still missing
stories.summary: A flash flood tore through part of the Grand Canyon, killing at least two people with more than a dozen still missing. Search efforts continue as officials warn of the danger of rapid water in the canyon's narrow slots.

stories.title: Dozens of American families still waiting for news after Nepal flood
stories.summary: U.S. officials confirm American citizens remain unaccounted for in the Nepal flash flood, leaving families without answers a week on. The case underscores how far the disaster's toll reaches beyond the region.

stories.title: Messi announces retirement from Argentina's national team
stories.summary: Lionel Messi said he is retiring from playing for Argentina's national side after a career spanning six World Cups, including the 2022 title in Qatar and a runner-up finish in 2026. His departure closes one of the most decorated international careers in soccer history.

stories.title: Kalshi bans ex-Congressman George Santos for life over suspected insider trading
stories.summary: Betting platform Kalshi said it permanently banned former U.S. Rep. George Santos after concluding he likely traded on non-public information. The move adds another legal headache for Santos, who has faced repeated fraud and ethics scrutiny.

stories.title: OpenAI launches GPT-6 Astra, calling it a 'generational leap'
stories.summary: OpenAI released GPT-6 Astra, its most capable model for complex coding, research and computer-use tasks, with president Greg Brockman calling it a generational leap toward AGI. Access to its most advanced cybersecurity capabilities will be limited.

stories.title: Nvidia confirms it will buy Hugging Face for $12.9 billion
stories.summary: Nvidia confirmed plans to acquire AI hub Hugging Face for $12.9 billion, one of the largest deals in the AI ecosystem. The purchase gives Nvidia control of a central platform where developers share and host open-source models.

stories.title: OpenAI's new reasoning technique alarms AI safety experts
stories.summary: A technique tied to OpenAI's Astra model, which is adept at breaking into computer systems, is drawing concern from AI safety researchers. Experts warn the capability raises questions about how well the frontier model can be contained.

stories.title: US government sides with OpenAI on training on copyrighted material
stories.summary: The U.S. government signaled support for OpenAI's position that training large language models on copyrighted material can be fair use. The stance could shape the legal ground for how AI companies build and train their models.

stories.title: Anthropic's new Fable release is cheaper and less restrictive
stories.summary: Anthropic issued a new Fable release that lowers cost and relaxes usage limits on its models. The move positions Anthropic to better compete on price while keeping capability.

stories.title: Browns name Deshaun Watson starting QB, make roster moves
stories.summary: Cleveland named Deshaun Watson its starting quarterback for the 2026 season after a preseason competition with Shedeur Sanders; coach Kevin Stefanski said Watson gives the team its best chance to win. The decision triggered further roster adjustments, including waiving TE Dea'Quan Wright, who may return to college at LSU.

stories.title: Mild surprises as Browns finalize 53-man roster
stories.summary: The Browns trimmed to their 53-man roster with a few surprises on the cut list, including Logan Fano and Gage Larvadain. Roster decisions set the team's final shape headed into the Sept. 13 opener at Jacksonville.

stories.title: Browns' biggest cutdown move: trimming 4 QBs to 3 without cutting a passer
stories.summary: The Browns reshaped their quarterbacks room from four passers to three without waiving or trading any of them, a deliberate staffing decision during cutdowns. It signals how Cleveland plans to manage depth at the sport's most important position.

stories.title: Winners and losers from the Browns' 53-man roster cutdown
stories.summary: Breakdowns of the Browns' final roster cut to 53 point to wins for players who earned spots and losses for veterans left off, with the picture setting expectations for Week 1. The roster balance reflects Cleveland's preseason performance.

stories.title: Report: Browns moving on from preseason standout wide receiver
stories.summary: Reports indicate the Browns are parting with a wide receiver who impressed during the preseason, part of the final roster trimming. The move frees a spot for players the coaching staff projects higher for the regular season.

stories.title: Ohio State vs. Ball State preview: Buckeyes huge favorites in opener
stories.summary: Ohio State opens the 2026 season against Ball State favored by 50.5 points, with the roster gap expected to make for a lopsided opener. The game is a chance for new starters and young skill players to establish themselves.

stories.title: Ohio State releases 'The Bell Tolls' hype video for season opener
stories.summary: Ohio State dropped its latest hype video, themed 'The Bell Tolls,' ahead of Saturday's 12:30 p.m. kickoff against Ball State. It's part of the program's build-up for the 2026 season opener on Sept. 5.

stories.title: Five bold predictions for Ohio State vs. Ball State opener
stories.summary: Pundits expect a memorable debut for Ohio State skill players, predicting multiple touchdowns from running back Legend Bey in the opener. The projections set the tone for a season-opening blowout at 12:30 p.m. Saturday.

stories.title: How to watch Ohio State vs. Ball State: channel, date, time
stories.summary: Ohio State hosts Ball State on Saturday, Sept. 5 at 12:30 p.m. ET, with broadcast details set for the Buckeyes' 2026 opener. Fans can find where to tune in for the first game of the season.

stories.title: The Beat: OSU season-opening intrigue starts with personnel and game plan
stories.summary: Analysts say Ohio State's real intrigue for the opener lies in its personnel groupings and game-plan approach rather than the result. How new faces are deployed against Ball State could preview the season ahead.

stories.title: Leclerc leads Ferrari 1-2 in first Italian GP practice at Monza
stories.summary: Charles Leclerc set the pace in FP1 at the Italian Grand Prix, leading a Ferrari one-two with teammate Lewis Hamilton on home soil as the Tifosi turned out in force. It marked a strong start to Ferrari's Monza weekend.

stories.title: Russell tops second Monza practice ahead of Leclerc and Antonelli
stories.summary: George Russell set the fastest lap in FP2 at the Italian GP, edging Ferrari's Leclerc by 0.120s. Mercedes and Ferrari traded the top slots in Friday practice on the high-speed Monza layout.

stories.title: Gasly loses Monaco GP podium as FIA Court of Appeal reinstates penalties
stories.summary: The FIA's International Court of Appeal reinstated Pierre Gasly's pit-lane speeding penalties, dropping the Alpine driver from third to seventh at a reconfirmed Monaco GP and re-awarding the podium to Red Bull's Isack Hadjar. The ruling overturned an earlier decision that had rescinded the penalties.

stories.title: F1 teams agree to shorten races to 290km starting in 2027
stories.summary: All 11 F1 teams backed a proposal to cut standard Grand Prix distance from 305km to about 290km from 2027, the first such reduction in decades. The change responds to higher fuel demands from the next-generation hybrid engines.

stories.title: Briatore accuses judge of McLaren links after Gasly loses podium
stories.summary: Alpine boss Flavio Briatore questioned the integrity of the Monaco GP appeal at a fiery Monza press conference, alleging a judge had ties to McLaren. The comments add tension to a ruling that reshaped the championship standings.

stories.title: Escape from Tarkov ships Patch 1.1.0.0 with first season and free Battle Pass
stories.summary: Patch 1.1.0.0 launched Tarkov's first-ever season, Kord Breach, adding a free Battle Pass with progression shared across all game modes. The update is the biggest seasonal shake-up for the hardcore shooter, introducing new rules and rewards.

stories.title: Kord Breach Season 1 guide: what's new in Tarkov's first season
stories.summary: A guide to Kord Breach, Tarkov's first season launched in Patch 1.1.0.0 on Aug. 3, walks players through the new optional Seasonal Character, modifiers, rewards and gameplay changes. It's the template for how Tarkov plans to run future seasons.

stories.title: Kord Breach Season 1 dates, rewards and modifiers detailed
stories.summary: Kord Breach Season 1 opened Aug. 3 with the 1.1.0.0 install, with servers down about 6-8 hours during deployment. Season trackers map out the modifiers, rewards and seasonal timeline players can expect.

stories.title: Tarkov community breaks down 1.1.0.0 patch notes and new Seasons system
stories.summary: Players on r/EscapefromTarkov discussed the 1.1.0.0 notes, focusing on the new Seasons system that introduces fresh rules, mechanics and rewards each season. The community conversation captures early reactions to Tarkov's biggest systematic change.

stories.title: Tarkov teams up with GearUP to reduce lag and packet loss
stories.summary: Battlestate Games announced an Escape from Tarkov x GearUP collaboration aimed at minimizing packet loss and connection spikes through dedicated network routing. The partnership targets a long-running complaint about the game's online stability.

stories.title: AT&T outage hits Franklin County, could disrupt 911 and police lines
stories.summary: AT&T reported outages in Franklin County that could affect customers calling 911 or police non-emergency numbers. Columbus residents are urged to know alternate ways to reach emergency services during the disruption.

stories.title: 6-year-old critical after shooting near Weinland Park in Columbus
stories.summary: A 6-year-old is in critical condition after a shooting in the 1200 block of North 6th Street in the Weinland Park area. Police are investigating the incident, which put a child hospitalized.

stories.title: Gahanna Civic Center move: what residents need to know
stories.summary: Gahanna's new Civic Center will house City Hall operations and the Division of Police headquarters as the city relocates its municipal functions. Officials outlined what residents should expect during the transition.

stories.title: Gahanna issues flooding update after rainy week of property damage
stories.summary: The City of Gahanna updated residents on extensive rainfall and flooding that damaged properties, providing guidance on reporting and recovery. The weekend storms affected homes across the area.

stories.title: Ohio hits 44 confirmed tornadoes so far in 2026, a busy season
stories.summary: Ohio has now logged 44 confirmed tornadoes in 2026, with 29 during an active July and August. The year is shaping up as one of the state's more storm-heavy on record.
